query:
SELECT
            a.id as "id?",
            i.id as "auth_id?",
            COALESCE(a.full_name, a.label, i.full_name) AS "full_name?",
            CASE WHEN r.id IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object('label', r.label, 'id', r.id) END AS "room: RoomEmbed"
        FROM
            accounts_people a
            FULL JOIN identities i ON i.id = a.auth_id
            LEFT JOIN res_leases l ON a.id = l.tenant_id
            LEFT JOIN res_rooms r ON l.room_id = r.id JOIN account_group_memberships agm ON a.id = agm.account_id WHERE agm.group_id = ANY($1) AND COALESCE(a.full_name, a.label) ILIKE '%' || $2 || '%' OR r.label ILIKE '%' || $2 || '%' AND r.label IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (a.id IS NULL) DESC, (i.id IS NULL) DESC, r.label DESC LIMIT $3 OFFSET $4
